definitions.gloss: net assets; net worth; shareholders' equity
definitions.explanation: Total assets minus total liabilities. Used both for companies (the equity section of the balance sheet) and for individuals or funds (net worth).

examples.japanese: {純資産|じゅんしさん}が{減|へ}った。
この{会社|かいしゃ}の{純資産|じゅんしさん}は{十億円|じゅうおくえん}を{超|こ}えている。
examples.english: This company's net assets exceed one billion yen.

examples.japanese: {総資産|そうしさん}から{負債|ふさい}を{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いたものが{純資産|じゅんしさん}である。
examples.english: Net assets are what remains after subtracting liabilities from total assets.

notes:
Formed from {純|じゅん} (pure, net) plus {資産|しさん} (assets). Since the 2006 revision of Japanese accounting standards, {純資産|じゅんしさん} is the official balance-sheet heading that replaced the older {資本|しほん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純資産|じゅんしさん}の{部|ぶ}: the net assets section (of a balance sheet)
- {純資産|じゅんしさん}{総額|そうがく}: total net assets
- {一株|ひとかぶ}{当|あ}たり{純資産|じゅんしさん}: net assets per share

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自己資本|じこしほん}: own capital, equity — nearly synonymous, but excludes some minority-interest items
- {総資産|そうしさん}: total assets — the gross figure before liabilities are subtracted
